correctness.rationale: Exact classification: switching to the unique star-positive K_n representative leaves 2^((n-1 choose 2)) signings. Triangle parity is invariant under switching; frustration is the minimum number of sign disagreements with all cuts. Independent complete normalized enumeration, including all vertex permutations, yields n=3 rows (0,0),(1,1); n=4 rows (0,0),(2,1),(4,2); n=5 seven rows (0,0,1),(3,1,10),(4,2,15),(5,3,12),(6,2,15),(7,3,10),(10,4,1). The unique strict conflict is (U,L)=(5,3) path-negative vs (6,2) two-edge matching. Their F values 2/5,3/5 and T values 1/2,2/5. Enumeration is genuinely exhaustive through n=5, rather than an extrapolation to larger n.
